description.zh: 加速域名，仅支持修改单个域名。
description.en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name in each request.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
回源地址列表。

> 不支持同时传入**Sources**和**TopLevelDomain**参数，如果您同时传入**Sources**和**TopLevelDomain**参数，**TopLevelDomain**将不生效。
description.en:
The information about the addresses of origin servers.

> Do not set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time. If you set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time, **TopLevelDomain** does not take effect.

description.zh:
顶级接入域。只有白名单用户CDN_TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN_GREY_USER_LIST设置才有效。

> 不支持同时传入**Sources**和**TopLevelDomain**参数，如果您同时传入**Sources**和**TopLevelDomain**参数，**TopLevelDomain**将不生效。
description.en:
The root domain. To add a root domain name, you must be added to the whitelist specified by the CDN\_TOP\_LEVEL\_DOMAIN\_GREY\_USER\_LIST parameter.

> Do not set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time. If you set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time, **TopLevelDomain** does not take effect.

descriptions.en: > Each account can call this operation up to 30 times per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn modify-cdn-domain --domain-name example.com --sources content_:_1.1.1.1_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:80,_weight_:_15 --resource-group-id rg-acfmyuji4b6r400 --top-level-domain aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
